title: 환경정책기본법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Standards and Methods for Establishing Provincial and Municipal Environmental Plans)
(1) Provincial and municipal environmental plans (hereinafter referred to as "provincial and municipal environmental plans") in accordance with Article 18(1) of the Act must be consistent with the National Environmental Comprehensive Plan (hereinafter referred to as "National Environmental Comprehensive Plan") in accordance with Article 14 of the Act.
(2) The governor of a province or municipality must prepare a provincial and municipal environmental plan, including the following matters:
1. Analysis of the current situation and management and conservation plans related to the following items:
a. Natural and ecological environment, including ecosystems and biodiversity
b. Living and climate environment, including air, water, soil, and climate
2. Organizational structure and budget for the implementation of the provincial and municipal environmental plan.
(3) In addition to the matters stipulated in paragraphs (1) and (2), the Minister of the Ministry of Climate and Energy shall determine the necessary matters for the standards and methods for establishing and preparing provincial and municipal environmental plans. <Amended as of 2025.10.1>
